title: DLMF 5.18 𝑞-Gamma and 𝑞-Beta Functions: Also, \ln\Gamma_{q}\left(x\right) is convex for x>0 , and the analog of the Bohr–Mollerup theorem (§ 5.5(iv) ) holds.
summary: DLMF 5.18 𝑞-Gamma and 𝑞-Beta Functions: Also, \ln\Gamma_{q}\left(x\right) is convex for x>0 , and the analog of the Bohr–Mollerup theorem (§ 5.5(iv) ) holds.
body: NIST DLMF section 5.18 (𝑞-Gamma and 𝑞-Beta Functions) says: "Also, \ln\Gamma_{q}\left(x\right) is convex for x>0 , and the analog of the Bohr–Mollerup theorem (§ 5.5(iv) ) holds. For generalized asymptotic expansions of \ln\Gamma_{q}\left(z\right) as |z|\to\infty see Olde Daalhuis ( 1994 ) and Moak ( 1984 ) . For the q -digamma or q -psi function \psi_{q}(z)=\Gamma_{q}'\left(z\right)/\Gamma_{q}\left(z\right) see Salem ( 2013 ) ." Equation 5.18.1 on the page has alt text "\left(a;q\right)_{n}=\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(1-aq^{k}),". Equation 5.18.2 on the page has alt text "n!_{q}=1(1+q)\cdots(1+q+\dots+q^{n-1})=\left(q;q\right)_{n}(1-q)^{-n}.". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
